name: ACC.27 Together with WCC (ACC Annual Scientific Session 2027)
description: ACC.27 Together with WCC is the American College of Cardiology's annual scientific session, held jointly with the World Heart Federation's World Congress of Cardiology. The meeting presents cardiovascular research across more than 60 topic areas including cardio oncology, digital health, and sports cardiology.
